changelog:
Major Update - 15/07/2026

• The UI fully saves settings inside the local folder now (it used to save in registry certain settings and values)
• Loader has multiple changes and updates, acrylic is supported and the fetching weao and checking for updates speeds have been massivly improved
• Fixed Account Manager's Join Server action
• Slightly redesigned the servers page in Account Manager
• Added an Open Roblox button for the selected account
• Added History: closed tabs are saved under Files > History and can be recovered; this can be disabled in Settings
• Added tab drag-and-drop to Files; hold and drag a tab into Scripts or AutoExec to save it as a .lua script
• Fixed the Settings search bar not working and breaking the entire UI
• Added an option to start the UI automatically with Windows
• Added options to automatically spoof the MAC address when the UI opens or closes
• Added options to automatically clear Roblox cookies when the UI opens or closes
• Added options to automatically clean Roblox when the UI opens or closes
• Fixed Auto Execute always running and failing to detect .lua and .txt files
• Added a Duplicate option for tabs in the context menu
• Added page caching so pages preserve their content and remember their positions
• Added an adjustable console line limit in Miscellaneous settings
• Added the Acrylic setting in Interface settings, enabled unfocused opacity control, and removed the old opacity setting
• Many bug fixes, UI improvements, visual fixes, and visual changes
